title: UE5 Shader Compilation Stutter from PSO Cache Misses
root_cause: UE5's PSO (Pipeline State Object) cache misses during gameplay cause shader compilation on foreground thread. stutter occurs when encountering new material combinations not in startup PSO cache.
resolution_type: Async shader compilation with placeholder fallback. Background pipeline warming based on level analysis. Deterministic PSO pre-warming from recorded gameplay traces.
